games.name: drawbluff
games.title: Drawbluff
games.summary: Draw your prompt, fake the others' titles, find the real one

screenshots.alt: The TV showing a drawing of a seagull flying off with a swimmer's sandwich in a gold frame and seven titles to vote on, one of them real
Drawing a snowman sweating in a sauna for the prompt on a phone
Picking the real title of the seagull drawing on a phone

games.name: jinx
games.title: Jinx
games.summary: One team, one word each to make the guesser say the secret word; the same clue twice jinxes both

screenshots.alt: The TV: four clue cards turned (CAPE, GARLIC, TWILIGHT, COFFIN), a bold one still face down, the guess VAMPIRE being typed on a label tape
The guesser's phone: four clues turned, the bold card left face down, five cards survived and two jinxed, VAMPIRE being typed
Drawing your face for the table on a phone, the players listed below

games.name: garble
games.title: Garble
games.summary: One picture each goes round the table: guess what it is now, then draw your word on top of it; nothing is ever erased

screenshots.alt: The TV rebuilding a picture layer by layer, each in its drawer's colour: Mia's sun, Jonas's lion mane and muzzle on top of it, Lena's clock numbers and hands on top of that, each layer's word beside it with the next player's guess (sun, right; lion, right; lion again, wrong)
Turning someone's cat into a submarine on a phone: the cat's lines a shade lighter, a tower, a periscope, portholes, a propeller and waves drawn on top in black
Guessing on a phone what the picture is now: a cat, the guess typed below it

games.name: krakel
games.title: Krakel
games.summary: Everyone draws a word of the same category (or, mixed, of any); the TV redraws each picture stroke by stroke, and the sooner you type what it is, the more you and the artist score

screenshots.alt: The TV redrawing Mia's picture under a pencil: a grey shape with four legs and a big pink ear so far, eight blanks for its letters, a pencil for the time left; Lena has it (first, +900), Phil's hippo and Jonas's rhino are struck out
Drawing a giraffe on a phone: yellow with brown spots, the pens in thirteen colours, an eraser, four widths and undo below the pad
Guessing on a phone: the same half-drawn picture, hippo was wrong, elephant typed and about to be sent

games.name: shifty
games.title: Shifty
games.summary: Everyone but the phony knows the secret word on a board of sixteen; one-word clues are typed while the TV shows the typing as a lie detector's needle, then the room accuses someone and the phony can still win by naming the word

screenshots.alt: The TV in neon: four fedora silhouettes outlined in their colours in front of glowing height lines, Phil red in the searchlight typing his clue as three lit tiles, his oscilloscope kicking where he deleted a false start; Mia's spots and Lena's savanna on glass cards below their traces; sixteen zoo animals on backlit tiles framed as evidence

The verdict: red lasers from every name plate to the accused, three on Lena and one on Jonas, a red neon PHONY sign over Lena in the searchlight; the clues spots, savanna, neck and leaves under the traces
A phone's card turned up: the word giraffe in amber neon, the category zoo animals, and the board's glowing tiles below
Phil's turn on his phone: nec typed in the glowing clue field, the time running out, his card face down (red stripes, cyan eyes) above the board

games.name: landgrab
games.title: Landgrab
games.summary: Conquer a world of hex tiles: everyone plans their armies' moves on the phone at the same time, then the TV plays out every march and battle with the dice

screenshots.alt: The TV while five generals plan: the world as raised hex tiles in their colours and the parchment of the wild lands, every territory named with its army count, the continents' bonuses written in the seas, four of five players ticked ready and 88 seconds left
A battle on the TV: the camera close on New Guinea and Indonesia, the rest of the map dimmed, the fight card with Lena's three dice against the wild lands' one and a banner: Conquered!
Planning on a phone: the map fills the screen, close on Europe and Africa with the player's two orders drawn as arrows, the Move & attack step with 2 orders, Ready at the bottom
An attack on a phone: tap Western Europe, then Britain, and the bar under the map becomes the amount, 4 armies with a 97 % chance to win, quick amounts Half, Safe and All, a slider and Attack with 4

games.name: crosstalk
games.title: Crosstalk
games.summary: Two spymasters send secret clues to their teams' phones, both teams guess at once on one board of 25 words, and everyone can hear what the other team says

screenshots.alt: The TV in round 3: a board of 25 word cards, eight turned in red and blue; Red (spymaster Mia) has 4 of 8 and is still guessing, Blue (spymaster Sara) has 3 of 8 and has locked its card, the clock at 27 seconds

Guessing on Blue's phone: the secret clue NIGHT 2, Phil's pin on GHOST and Ava's on CASTLE, one more pin needed to lock; below, the team's pad: "NOT this one: MOON", "they whispered 'space', so not ROCKET", "left over for later: PIANO", "careful with BRIDGE"
The spymaster's phone: the key with every card in its colour and the assassin SHARK in black, "Say nothing. Show nothing.", the clue SAILOR typed for 3 cards and about to be sent

games.name: snug
games.title: Snug
games.summary: Fill one shape together with candy pieces nobody else can see until they are placed, talk and point, and beat the team clock

screenshots.alt: The TV during shape 1: a quilted cream cushion on a pink polka-dot background, a blue and three pink candy pieces with little faces placed on it, the cursors of Phil, Lena and Mia and a ping ring, the team down the left with a wrapped sweet for each piece still in hand, the clock at 4:46
The shape filled: every candy smiles with its eyes closed, "Snug!" over the board, confetti, +30 s beside the clock, "Lena placed the last piece", and each player's spare piece that was not needed
Time's up on shape 2: the board as the solution would have filled it, in the owners' colours, and the pieces each player still held beside their name
The lobby: the puffy snug logo with a bow, how to play in three steps, the join QR code in a candy-striped card, and the players as candies in a jar
Phil's phone: the shape with the pieces placed so far and the others' cursors, and below it his own three secret pieces, each with a flip button

games.name: busted
games.title: Busted
games.summary: A gossip paper about the room: rank who would most likely do it and the winner makes the front page with a title; answer a question anonymously and guess who wrote what; suggest your own questions and the room rates them

screenshots.alt: The front page of The Daily Busted after a vote: EXCLUSIVE, Lena's hand-drawn press photo taped on, her name huge and her new title in red, Sleepyhead of the Year, with a short article on how many sources gave gold

An answer round's reveal: an anonymous typed note, the guessers' faces on the photos they named, the writer's photo clipped onto the note and a stamp: BUSTED! when most guessed right, GOT AWAY when not
Phil's phone ranking who would most likely sleep through an entire day: the players' press photos with gold, silver and bronze medals and a File it button
Phil's phone matching the anonymous answers to their writers, a face beside each note, a heart on his favourite and his own note greyed out

games.name: pinch
games.title: Pinch
games.summary: A 1920s heist in real time: one thief sneaks through a dark estate for the loot and the getaway car, everyone else is house security with flashlights, and the TV is the radio the thief can hear

screenshots.alt: The TV during a heist: the estate as a blueprint with two houses, gardens, lamps and parking spots, the red pencil hatch of where the thief could be, the night's catalogue with GPS-tagged items down the left, the clock at 0:30 and the ticker: SYSTEM ARMED. ALL QUIET. FOR NOW.

The tape after a heist: a VHS replay of the estate in full colour, the thief's line to the getaway car, the guards' dashed paths, a post mark, and the caption: Ben reaches the car with $12,400. Nobody checked the car.
The outcome: GOT AWAY in gold Deco letters under the thief's portrait, and: Ben is gone. Security is still looking under the sofa.
The lobby: the PINCH logo on a sunburst, how to play in three steps, the join QR code and the guests as bowler hats in their colours
The thief's phone: a lit bedroom in colour amid the dark blueprint, a GPS-tagged item in the sack, an arrow towards the car, and buttons to take a diamond ring or a lava lamp
A guard's phone: lit rooms around the corridor, two guards in bowler hats with their flashlights, the blueprint beyond, and the buttons for the flashlight, a door and the lights
